question:
Consider the following statements about the 61st National Chess Championship:

1. The event was hosted in Gurgaon.

2. GM Karthik Venkataraman clinched the title.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3 (Both 1 and 2)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1:** The event was hosted in **Gurgaon**.

 
 
• The **61st National Chess Championship** was indeed hosted in Gurgaon, a city in Haryana, India.
 
• This location was chosen due to its ability to accommodate large-scale events and provide necessary facilities for participants.
 
• *Hence, statement 1 is correct.*
 
 
 
• **Statement 2:** GM **Karthik Venkataraman** clinched the title.
 
 
• GM (Grandmaster) **Karthik Venkataraman**, a renowned chess player, emerged victorious in the 61st National Chess Championship.
 
• This achievement highlights his skill and dedication in the field of chess.
 
• *Hence, statement 2 is correct.*
 
 
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Option 3 (Both 1 and 2).***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the National Chess Championship:**

 
 
• The National Chess Championship is one of the most prestigious chess tournaments in **India**.
 
• It is organized annually and attracts top chess players from across the country.
 
• The championship provides a platform for players to showcase their talent and compete at the highest level.
 
 
 
• **Grandmaster Title:**
 
 
• **Grandmaster (GM)** is the highest title awarded to chess players by the **FIDE (International Chess Federation)**.
 
• This title is a recognition of exceptional skill, consistency, and performance in chess tournaments.
 
• GM Karthik Venkataraman’s victory further solidifies his position as one of India’s leading chess players.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Gurgaon as the Host:**
 
 
• **Gurgaon**, located in Haryana, is known for its modern infrastructure and connectivity.
 
• It has become a popular venue for hosting national-level events due to its accessibility and resources.
 
• The city’s hosting of the 61st National Chess Championship reflects its growing importance in the sports landscape of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Achievements of GM Karthik Venkataraman:**

 
 
• GM Karthik Venkataraman has consistently performed well in national and international chess tournaments.
 
• His victory in the 61st National Chess Championship is a testament to his strategic thinking and mastery of the game.
 
• He is considered a role model for aspiring chess players in India.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Indian Chess:**
 
 
• Events like the National Chess Championship play a vital role in promoting chess at the grassroots level.
 
• They provide opportunities for young players to compete and learn from seasoned professionals.
 
• Such tournaments also contribute to India’s growing reputation as a chess powerhouse on the global stage.
